mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rates and declining unemployment signals a tightening monetary policy amid strong labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, strong housing starts and consumer credit growth indicate robust economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST and RSAFS are both above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that typically reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has increased over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 104.5, it signals strong economic output that typically precedes a period of inflationary pressure and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 104.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery phases, a rising industrial production combined with expanding GDP growth signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during early recovery when INDPRO and GDPC1 are both above their 6-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and industrial production indicates robust economic activity across both demand and supply sides, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
